description: After the scoresheet's Save PDF: the scoresheet windows (popup-<n>, popups.rs) and the scoretable window, loaded from the built-in server on http://localhost, may open a file the app downloaded or show it in its folder. The commands take only the id of a download the app recorded and checked itself (popups.rs on_download), never a path. LAN tablets are plain browsers and never get these commands.
